findings.pattern: the applicant journey was implicit and the primary task read as a generic catalog
findings.semanticTest: Every visible step maps to an existing user action: find, verify at source, compare, prepare locally, and export or share.
findings.replacement: Added one compact semantic workflow navigation using the existing AVDS adapter instead of decorative feature cards.

findings.pattern: comparison and export capabilities existed without an owned action group in the catalog
findings.semanticTest: The group owns three concrete outcomes: open a selected comparison, export the current result set, or share the current view.
findings.replacement: Placed the existing comparison, CSV, ICS, and share functions in one compact task-owned action group; no decorative controls were added.

findings.pattern: a radial glow and translucent blurred header added generic premium chrome to a technical reference page
findings.semanticTest: The header only owns navigation, title context, and language selection; it does not represent a layered or floating object.
findings.replacement: Returned the page and header to opaque AVDS surfaces and borders, preserving the Swagger documentation hierarchy.
